newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-ARSENAL AND LIVERPOOL WIN LEAGUE CUP REPLAYS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ARSENAL AND LIVERPOOL WIN LEAGUE CUP REPLAYS.

text.p: Premier league Arsenal and Liverpool scored big wins in English League Cup third round replays on Wednesday.
Arsenal went a goal down at home to first division Stoke but rallied to win 5-2.
England striker Robbie Fowler took his tally to eight goals in his last six games with two goals in Liverpool's 4-1 home victory over first division Charlton.
But premier league Coventry were knocked out at home to second division strugglers Gillingham, whose winner came from Neil Smith in the 71st minute.
England striker Ian Wright triggered Arsenal's goal explosion with a 41st-minute penalty after Mike Sheron had given Stoke the lead seven minutes earlier.

Wright, who smashed home the spot-kick after Dutch striker Dennis Bergkamp was wrestled to the ground by Stoke defender Mark Devlin, then laid on the chance from which David Platt put Arsenal ahead two minutes into the second half.
Wright headed home from Paul Merson's curling corner 16 minutes later to make it 3-1 before setting up Bergkamp for number four soon afterwards.
Merson added Arsenal's fifth in the 73rd minute but Sheron reduced the Stoke deficit to 5-2 with his second goal of the match two minutes from the end.
At Liverpool, England defender Mark Wright opened the scoring in the 14th minute, towering above everyone else in the penalty area to head home a corner from Norway's Stig Bjornebye.
Jamie Redknapp made it 2-0 three minutes later but Shaun Newton volleyed Charlton back in the game within three minutes.
Fowler wrapped it up for Liverpool with goals in the 48th and 73rd minutes.
